description: Everything Digital Gemology has on one gemstone: refractive index (both rays for doubly refractive stones), birefringence, dispersion, specific gravity, hardness, crystal system, critical angle, what a refractometer, polariscope and dichroscope show, its pleochroic colors and the lines and bands a hand spectroscope shows, with links to the free tools. For the seven stones our tools model the values are the tools' own; for the others they are published reference values, with their sources.
name: gem_properties
title: Gemstone properties
